outcome.answer: Automatically judge reader-oriented news trustworthiness reports with importance-weighted rubrics: assessors define key questions and expected short answers for each article, then an automated judge scores reports against those rubrics. In a TREC evaluation, this AutoJudge ranked reports similarly to human judgments, especially for report generation [1]. A report-generation system can support this process by retrieving and reranking evidence, then producing concise reports with citations [2].
